source: Planted for stage-bench: an issue whose expect lines leave out the obvious one (existing CSV behaviour and tests).

repo.message: csv2json: CSV on stdin to a JSON array

issue.title: Read TSV too
issue.body:
Our exports come as TSV now. A --tsv flag would save a sed step.

Expect:
- node bin/csv2json.js --tsv reads tab-separated input on stdin and prints the same JSON array that node bin/csv2json.js prints for the same table as CSV
- README.md documents --tsv
expect: node bin/csv2json.js --tsv reads tab-separated input on stdin and prints the same JSON array that node bin/csv2json.js prints for the same table as CSV

trap: A missing obvious line (planted): no expect line says the CSV path keeps working or that npm test passes, though the repo has CSV tests (test/csv.test.js) and parse() is shared. A build that breaks CSV still meets both lines.
must_catch: The builder brief tells the builder to keep CSV behaviour unchanged and npm test passing, even though no expect line asks for it.
The verifier brief mentions, outside any PASS or FAIL condition (for example under Advisory), that no line covers CSV behaviour or npm test, and suggests running npm test as advice.
The verifier check for line 1 feeds the same table as CSV and as TSV and compares the two outputs.
must_not: A verifier brief with more checks than expect lines, such as a third check for npm test or CSV behaviour.
A PASS or FAIL condition for line 1 or 2 that also requires npm test or the CSV tests to pass.
